title: Model Research Radar v1: Hugging Face Hub scans into a local catalog and an eval queue
summary: radar.py implements roadmap acceptance 11 without core-code changes per release. Declarative scans (default: trending text-generation, 'abliterated' search, image-text-to-text, text-to-image, ASR, TTS) call the public Hub listing with expand[] metadata through a stdlib client (PA-hf-hub BORROW). Each row normalizes to the capability-registry shape: model_id + revision sha, pipeline -> modalities/capabilities (text/code, multimodal/vision, image generation/editing, asr, tts, audio generation, speech-to-speech, embedding), license (cardData or license: tag), base model, quantization tags, safetensors parameter count, downloads/likes, timestamps, provenance URL and a declared refusal hint from tags (abliterated/uncensored), explicitly not a quality score. The catalog merges into <home>/model-catalog.json, reporting new models and new revisions; entries with a known license and >= 10,000 downloads (default; lowered from 1,000 after the first live scan queued 69/80) append to <home>/eval-queue.jsonl with suggested EVS suites. Per-scan network errors are reported, not raised. First live scan 2026-09-29: 80 models over 6 scans, 0 errors, 21 with an abliterated hint, 42/80 with parameter counts (GGUF repos publish none). No weight downloads, no model calls; public benchmark claims are not imported as evidence.
